name: Goldi S.H. Chan
reason: Health rule (borderline): her own site (aquamarine-energy.com, in Chinese) frames her work around pain and conditions: the About page names chronic pain, post-surgery discomfort and bone problems, the Level 1 and Level 4 workshop pages sell pain relief and spinal correction and invite people with pain to attend, and the home-page testimonials are almost all about pain. She also presents as a psychotherapist and hypnotherapist. Her QT Level 1/2/4 workshops (Nov 2026 to Jan 2027, HK$3,500 to HK$4,350) and sessions would otherwise make a full page; owner may reconsider.
